# Nicolae Cojuhari (nicojuhari.com)

> Software engineer in Vienna, Austria. Websites and custom web apps for small businesses that bring more calls, bookings and orders - from the first click to a paying customer. Proof from his own businesses: Handwerker Netz (Vienna handyman service) gets 95%+ of its customers from its website and Google Maps.

## Services
- [Local Business Websites](https://nicojuhari.com/services/local-business-websites): website, Google Business Profile, SEO, landing pages for Google and Meta ads (better pages lower the cost per click and per customer), conversion fixes (CRO), tracking, automatic replies and follow-up. Shopify stores too.
- [Custom Web Apps & Automations](https://nicojuhari.com/services/custom-web-apps): internal tools, dashboards, connected tools, automated flows (n8n, Make, Zapier), AI agents and automations where they save time.
- [Softwareentwickler Wien (Deutsch)](https://nicojuhari.com/de/softwareentwickler-wien): the same offer in German, plus freelancer vs. agency comparison.

## Proof
- [Projects](https://nicojuhari.com/projects): Handwerker Netz, a consumer credit company system, EPUfix (invoicing for Austrian one-person businesses), 1FoodMenu.

## Free tools
- [All tools](https://nicojuhari.com/tools): social media image maker, Shopify product grid generator, bill split calculator, QR code generator, square image cropper and more. No sign-up.
